facts.title: roasted tomatoes and cipollini
ingredients: 1 pound small Roma or large cherry tomatoes
4 slices of country or ciabatta bread, one-inch thick
1 15-ounce can of white beans, drained and rinsed or 1 1/2 cups cooked beans of your choice
facts.yield_text: Serves four as a small dish, two as a main
facts.author: Deb Perelman
